name: Sariva
subtitle: Anantmool & Tulsi Scalp Reset
tagline: From India's Roots to Your Roots.
description: A deeply clarifying botanical reset for an over-stressed scalp. Sariva draws upon the cooling, purifying properties of Anantmool root and the adaptogenic grace of Tulsi to soothe irritation and restore harmony. Grounded in a hydrating coconut base and fortified with cleansing Neem, this oil gently sweeps away daily buildup and tension, cultivating a serene, balanced foundation for healthy hair to flourish.

ingredients.name: Anantmool Root
ingredients.role: Cools the scalp and calms redness and persistent irritation

ingredients.name: Tulsi Leaves
ingredients.role: Purifies the follicles and offers adaptogenic relief from environmental stress

ingredients.name: Neem
ingredients.role: Provides a profound cleanse to clarify buildup and ease flakiness

ingredients.name: Coconut
ingredients.role: Hydrates and nourishes to repair the scalp's natural moisture barrier

whyThisHerb: Anantmool offers an immediate, cooling reprieve to an inflamed scalp, while Tulsi steadily builds resilience, bringing a lasting sense of calm and clarity to your roots.

howToUse.title: Section
howToUse.description: Part your hair into clean sections to ensure the soothing oil reaches the scalp directly without obstruction.

howToUse.title: Soothe
howToUse.description: Using gentle pressure, massage the oil deeply into the roots to melt away tension and loosen buildup.

howToUse.title: Reset
howToUse.description: Allow the blend to sit for 45 minutes, letting the cooling botanicals restore harmony to the skin.

howToUse.title: Wash
howToUse.description: Cleanse thoroughly with a mild herbal shampoo to reveal a refreshed, quieted scalp.
